audit.why: Content and packet agree: level 3 is Ryze's Rune Prison window, 4-5 swing back to Karma's RW zoning, first item onward is Ryze. The full sides were a stale blanket.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma called he/him in 14+ fields; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim; dosFull[1].t told the player to keep a 'passive shield loaded' — current Ryze passive grants mana-scaling damage, not a shield; no anti-heal note despite her RW Mantra heal.
audit.why: Karma is she/her. Her W Focused Resolve is 12s flat, Mantra 40s at rank 1 reduced by her damaging spells, Q 9-5s. Ryze's passive per the kit file is bonus-mana damage plus AP-to-mana — the shield died in the rework, so the advice was wrong. RW heals her and extends the root, so Grievous timing matters (missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, cooldowns rewritten with 12s/40s/11s numbers, bleed bullets replaced with kit-grounded bodies, shield advice replaced with the real Q-reset loop, anti-heal added to itemization.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rune Prison has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
